Ana Chen: Quick preflight — finalizing marketplace listing with CloudStore + Nimbus hardware partners. Need embargo time, landing page LGTMs, and SI integration comms.
Mike Patel: Can we lock press embargo to next Tuesday 09:00 PT? that gives partners 72h to sign off.
Caroline Nguyen: Tuesday 09:00 PT works for marketing. CX wants the FAQ + support playbook by EOD Monday.
Samir Khan: SI teams (AdeptSys, BlueGrid) need the integration doc and sample certs today if possible. I can ping them.
Luis Romero: Confirming Nimbus will provide hardware bundle images by end of day. I'll escalate.
Ana Chen: Great — marketing, product, and partners: please add any non-negotiable blockers.
Caroline Nguyen: Landing page draft is up: https://docs.google.com/drafts/marketplace-landing. Need feature copy + partner logos approved.
Mike Patel: Logos: CloudStore already signed asset use, Nimbus needs legal OK (in flight). I'll drop the legal contact.
Samir Khan: Integration doc link: https://confluence.redwood/integrations/marketplace-si-guide — pushed required API keys section.
Ana Chen: We should publish the runbook for inbound leads and SI handoffs. Draft snippet below:
```
- Day 0 (launch): route new leads to partner-intake@redwood
- Day 1-3: SI outreach + technical onboarding checklist
- Escalations: use #partnerships-escalations
```
Luis Romero: Can we include a small callout for on-prem customers and Private offering? Partner PMs asked for it on the LP.
Caroline Nguyen: Yes — add a hero subline: "Bring Redwood Inference to your cloud or private environment" — short and approved by comms.
Mike Patel: Press embargo note: partners must sign asset release waiver by Monday 12:00 PT. I'll send a reminder. :email:
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled — embargo reminder to partners sent on Monday 11:00 PT. :robot_face:
Ana Chen: Action items: (1) Mike — partner waivers by Mon 12:00 PT; (2) Samir — certify SI docs + sample certs today; (3) Luis — Nimbus images by EOD; (4) Caroline — landing + FAQ ready Mon EOD. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
